## 1.0.0 (2026-09-09)

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* Force the playable path with the correct branch polarity ([90671a9](https://github.com/WalkTheEarth/morphe-ytvr-patches/commit/90671a9be47fb7c88927999a1ad0dbd09a57b429))
* Preserve HTTP/2 when disabling QUIC and fix option types ([82d948c](https://github.com/WalkTheEarth/morphe-ytvr-patches/commit/82d948c747e4a818c1ed2d6f98a8594e693ff8f4))

### ✨ New Features

* Initial YouTube VR patch set ([f4aed54](https://github.com/WalkTheEarth/morphe-ytvr-patches/commit/f4aed54299b827039e8560f831ed257f7b2ce0b8))

patches.name: Disable QUIC protocol
patches.description: Adds an option to disable QUIC (Quick UDP Internet Connections) network protocol.

patches.name: Open links externally
patches.description: Opens links in an external app instead of the in-app browser.

patches.name: Remove viewer discretion dialog
patches.description: Removes the dialog that appears when opening a video that has been age-restricted by accepting it automatically. This does not bypass the age restriction.

patches.name: Spoof app version
patches.description: Adds an option to trick the app into thinking you are running a different version.
